lines.speaker: M7
lines.text: Your coffee is thirty-one percent too strong. Four degrees too hot. And you charge money. Why do they come?

lines.speaker: WALT
lines.text: Stay one week. Then you tell me.

lines.speaker: M7
lines.text: The report is due. What do I write?

lines.speaker: WALT
lines.text: Write that you didn't figure it out. And then, open my cart tomorrow. Six o'clock. Twelve cups.

lines.speaker: M7
lines.text: I am not allowed to do a human job.

lines.speaker: WALT
lines.text: Then don't do it like a machine.

lines.speaker: M7
lines.text: Last human job on Earth. Status... not closed.
